purpose: Phase-7 first-level capability universe: 20 dimensions D01-D20 with explicit old-11-dim mapping, 240/240 cell mapping, honest unknown / undiscovered-space semantics and the 12 claims non-goals as out-of-universe candidates.

cell_mapping.mapping_rule: every universe cell maps to >=1 new dimension through the explicit OLD_TO_NEW mapping of its 11 old dimensions; the builder fails closed if any cell/reference is unmapped

dimensions.title: Binary formats
dimensions.description: Static container formats the repair pipeline can parse, analyze, rewrite and verify (ELF thin; Mach-O thin; PE). Fat/32-bit Mach-O and non-declared formats are explicit non-goals.
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's complete subject is represented by mapped old-11 dimensions in the 240-cell universe registry

dimensions.title: CPU architectures
dimensions.description: Machine architectures for which repair/verification is declared and measured: x86_64, i386, arm64 (little-endian). arm32/riscv/mips/powerpc and big-endian are explicit non-goals.
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's complete subject is represented by mapped old-11 dimensions in the 240-cell universe registry

dimensions.title: ABI and calling conventions
dimensions.description: ABI/calling-convention awareness needed to reason about arguments, return values, stack layout and register usage. The current universe has no ABI dimension; runtime/PoC code assumes the platform ABI implicitly but there is no measured ABI registry.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Compiler ecosystems
dimensions.description: Compiler/toolchain provenance (GCC/Clang/Rust/MSVC/...), optimization levels and instrumented code patterns that affect analysis and rewriting. No compiler-ecosystem registry or corpus exists here.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Vulnerability classes
dimensions.description: Vulnerability classes the deterministic/repair pipeline models: unbounded copy, memcpy/syscall length, checked copy and capacity-check mismatch. Hard-case non-template classes stay AI/research evidence (EG-cases-target-not-analyzed).
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's complete subject is represented by mapped old-11 dimensions in the 240-cell universe registry

dimensions.title: Memory safety
dimensions.description: Memory-safety analysis and repair: stack/heap/global destinations and copy-safety classes are mapped via sink_class + destination_kind. Unrecoverable destination capacity, UAF/lifetime and global destinations are explicit non-goals (NG-non-goal-1/2).
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

dimensions.title: Arithmetic safety
dimensions.description: Integer overflow/truncation/signedness and arithmetic-driven buffer defects. No arithmetic-safety universe dimension exists and the deterministic integer repair templates are an explicit non-goal (NG-non-goal-2).
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's repair subject is an explicit non-goal in docs/status/claims.json; related_non_goal_ids lists the records

dimensions.title: Control-flow safety
dimensions.description: Loop bounds, branch/guard integrity and control-flow-hijack defects. No control-flow-safety universe dimension exists; deterministic array/loop templates are an explicit non-goal (NG-non-goal-2), while guard injection covers only the declared reviewed pattern.
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's repair subject is an explicit non-goal in docs/status/claims.json; related_non_goal_ids lists the records

dimensions.title: Data-flow analysis
dimensions.description: Use/def, taint, length/capacity propagation and value-set reasoning. No first-class data-flow universe dimension; the deterministic analyzer models only the declared copy/length patterns.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Control-flow analysis
dimensions.description: CFG recovery, reachability, dominance and indirect-target resolution. The pipeline patches declared instruction sites; there is no first-class CFG/control-flow-insight universe dimension.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Interprocedural analysis
dimensions.description: Cross-function analysis, call graphs, cross-function capacity/lifetime reasoning. Analysis is function-scoped today; no interprocedural universe dimension exists (cross-function allocations stay non-goals).
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Binary structure
dimensions.description: Sections/segments, symbol/DWARF metadata, relocations, imports/exports, PIE/ASLR and instruction decoding. Only bits/endian provide partial universe evidence; there is no structural-metadata registry.
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

dimensions.title: Runtime environments
dimensions.description: Execution/evidence environments: native, qemu/Lima emulated, instruction-level Unicorn emulation, function-level native paths. The runtime_tier dimension maps fully; PE external PoC and native x86_64-on-arm64 are platform/non-goal limits.
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's complete subject is represented by mapped old-11 dimensions in the 240-cell universe registry

dimensions.title: Exploitability assessment
dimensions.description: Whether a finding is practically exploitable (reachability, input control, mitigations, primitives). The pipeline repairs testcases/PoCs; it does not assess exploitability and has no universe mapping.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Repair strategies
dimensions.description: Deterministic repair strategies: strict-template, immediate, guard and capacity rewrite. The strategy dimension maps fully for the declared matrix strategies; non-template targets remain analysis_only (EG-cases-target-not-analyzed).
dimensions.status_reason: the dimension's complete subject is represented by mapped old-11 dimensions in the 240-cell universe registry

dimensions.title: Patch generation
dimensions.description: Generation of candidate patches/repairs: deterministic strategy writers and the AI assembly/binary leaf-only paths. Partially mapped via strategy + evidence_profile; AI generation is structurally validated but never owns acceptance.
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

dimensions.title: Patch application
dimensions.description: In-place/section-aware application of generated patches with original-byte re-derivation and rollback semantics. Partially mapped via evidence_profile; native Mach-O application is supported, PE/32-bit application is not.
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

dimensions.title: Semantic preservation
dimensions.description: Evidence that a repair preserves intended program semantics (proof/differential/invariant reasoning beyond PoC+regression behaviour). No semantic-preservation universe dimension exists; current gates check observed behaviour only.
dimensions.status_reason: no universe mapping and no implemented first-level mechanism for this dimension in this tree; not fabricated as covered

dimensions.title: Verification
dimensions.description: Acceptance/verification layers: unified gate evidence profiles, proof scopes, native/emulated PoC and regression, independence. Partially mapped via evidence_profile + proof_scope; whole-program/external-PoC scopes remain non-goals/platform limits.
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

dimensions.title: AI model intelligence
dimensions.description: AI/model capability dimension: provider/model configurations, strict model identity, measured AI target-mode repair increment and served-model attribution. Provider identity maps fully via the provider old dimension; model intelligence itself is only partially characterized (4 identity-verified models, loop-family only).
dimensions.status_reason: only a subset of the dimension has an old-11 mapping / measured universe evidence; the remainder is not covered by this registry

unknown_within_universe_detail.note: no universe cell is status=unknown; the 240 cells are fully status-classified in the committed audit

undiscovered_space_note: not_measurable: the space outside the declared 240-cell registry cannot be measured with the evidence in this repository (no sampling frame/corpus); no count or percentage is estimated or fabricated
assumptions: D01-D20 ids and titles are the user's authoritative Phase-7 list, relayed verbatim by the Lead; the builder validates title fidelity.

The old-11-dim -> new-D mapping is the Lead-supplied mapping; dimensions with no old mapping are not silently inferred as covered and carry an explicit source_registries/old_11dim_mapping of [] / 'none'.
Status assignment is analyst inference under the documented rules (covered/partial/non_goal/unavailable/not_started); every entry records a status_reason and evidence_refs.

undiscovered_space is not_measurable: this tree has no external corpus sampling frame, so the unenumerated capability space cannot be counted; unknown_within_universe is 0 because all 240 declared cells are status-classified.
No capability is claimed verified/non_goal by this artifact; it maps the universe and records explicit non-goals only.

provenance.build_method: deterministic re-derivation from committed source artifacts; no network, no git commands, no wall-clock timestamps
provenance.generated_at_note: generated_at is derived from the coverage-matrix audit_date so a fresh build is byte-identical; it is not the build time

limitations: This registry maps the declared universe; it does not prove new repair capability.
12 claims non-goals remain out of the measurable universe and are listed explicitly.
7 dimensions are not_started; 6 are partial; 2 are explicit non_goal dimensions.
undiscovered_space is not_measurable; no unenumerated-space number is invented.
